recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast graphic featuring a central winged star emblem and slanted, energetic typography set against a solid dark background with a thin border frame.
coreVisualRelationships: The star emblem acts as the central geometric anchor.
The slanted text creates a dynamic diagonal counterpoint to the symmetrical logo.
The primary red and yellow palette creates high-vibrancy contrast against the black field.
Horizontal wing lines provide a sense of speed and stability.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The winged star emblem is centered horizontally and vertically in the lower two-thirds; the text is positioned in the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red star with yellow outlines.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the slanted top text, moves down to the central star, and follows the horizontal wings outward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample black space surrounds the central elements, emphasizing the graphic's silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black background provides the canvas for high-contrast elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red used for the main shapes and text fills.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow used for outlines and internal graphic details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Full saturation primary colors against a zero-value black background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight sans-serif with slight comic-book bounce.
letterConstructionRules: Rounded terminals on the display text
Angular, geometric construction for the logo-integrated text
Consistent 15-degree upward slant for the top message
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has a slightly exaggerated bottom curve
The 'R' features a straight diagonal leg
Internal logo text is stretched horizontally to fit the star's width
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A rounded, organic display face for the call-to-action paired with a rigid, geometric face for the brand mark.

preserve: The upward slant of the top text
The yellow outline on the red star

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, rounded, energetic feel of the top text.
Provides the geometric foundation for the internal logo text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A solid black square with a thin red border. In the center, a large red five-pointed star with a thick yellow outline. Behind the star, a yellow circle outline. Extending from the sides of the star are three horizontal yellow bars on each side, resembling wings.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place bold, red, uppercase sans-serif text in the top third of the frame. The text should be slanted upwards at a 15-degree angle and arranged in two slightly offset lines. Inside the central star, place geometric yellow uppercase text that follows the horizontal axis.

verificationChecks: Are the colors limited to red, yellow, and black?
Does the border maintain a consistent thin weight?

adjustableVariables: Slant angle of the top text
mustRedesign: Specific brand names or proprietary logos
Unique hand-drawn letter quirks that identify a specific artist
postGenerationChecks: Check that no gradients were accidentally introduced.
Ensure the red border is visible on all four sides.
Verify the yellow outlines are consistent in thickness.
Confirm the text does not touch the emblem.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a 1970s rock-and-roll star emblem with comic-book style slanted display type using a strict primary color palette on a black field.
